metadata.description: Hand-written Agent Skills for Claude that are worth reusing.

plugins.name: skill-writing
plugins.description: How to write a skill so it carries the thinking that produced a good result rather than the residue of the session it came from.

plugins.name: chrome-walkthrough
plugins.description: Teach someone to do a task in a web app with a guided, auto-advancing walkthrough overlaid on the live page in Chrome.

plugins.name: human-handoff
plugins.description: Turn AI-generated documents, decks and reports into something people can take in: write from a brief, read as a first-time reader would, cut what this reader would not miss, and make every sentence sound said.

plugins.name: north-star-review
plugins.description: Review a deck, doc, design or plan against a north star: a fresh agent sets what good looks like before the artifact can shape it, then the review checks against it, including what is missing.
